notes: Re-baselined 2026-09-05 at HEAD (dev). `allChunksGzipKB` still excludes the lazy CMUdict chunk (~939KB gzip, reported as `deferredChunksGzipKB`). History: 1275 = July 23 total (82 chunks); 1531 = Aug 18 (~111 chunks); 1780 = Aug 28 (136 chunks) after the WebGPU coach orb, scripted mission runner + catalog, syllable-level pronunciation scoring, journal notebook rebuild + UI sounds engine, SVGR illustration system, error-pattern taxonomy, and daily-plan grammar steps; 2046 = Sep 5 (154 chunks, ~2046KB gzip measured, reproducible on a clean build) after the hybrid offline-download feature (lib/offline, components/offline, LessonDownloadButton pulling in Dexie's full lib/db + IPA audio map), the courses/assessment/pronunciation-path redesign, and the phoneme-practice contrast-query split; 2042.3 = Sep 5 later same day after removing Zod validation from lib/essential-words/client.ts's browser runtime (kept in lib/essential-words/schema.ts for build/test time — that data is our own generated static asset, not user input). Note: `allChunksGzipKB` sums every non-deferred chunk file written to .next/static/chunks — it is total shipped JS across all routes, not a single page's download; next/dynamic code-splitting a component does not lower this number, it only relocates bytes into a different chunk file (confirmed empirically 2026-09-05 — wrapping LessonDownloadButton in next/dynamic raised the count via added chunk-boundary overhead). SearchModal + the ~66KB content index are already lazy-loaded behind Sidebar's search-open state, per the Aug 28 note; that is not reflected in this metric. `maxRouteGzipKB` (added 2026-09-05) complements it with a per-route ceiling: Turbopack's `next build` does not print Webpack's classic 'First Load JS' table, and no persisted Next manifest carries per-route sizes either, so this is computed from each route's `page_client-reference-manifest.js` (`clientModules[id].chunks`, deduped per route, gzip-summed) — see `measureRoutes()` in analyze-bundle.mjs. Baseline 575 = 521.6 (heaviest route, /daily, measured 2026-09-05) × 1.10 tolerance. Re-check `maxRouteName` in bundle-summary.json if this fails — a regression concentrated in one route is a different fix than aggregate growth. Biggest known eager chunks: Zod v4 (~63KB, many pages, mostly shared/server so removing one browser caller only trimmed ~4KB), the search index (~66KB gzip), lib/db's full Dexie schema (~1300 lines, pulled in by any client component importing @/lib/db, including LessonDownloadButton on every course-path row). CI allows +10% growth before failing.
